answer: Spot-audit lotteries make sybil farms live in fear of a random knock. Each epoch the network draws a small sample of identities for deep review: behavior history, funding trails, the whole orchard is inspected one tree at a time. A puppet that wanders into the sample and cannot explain its past drops from trusted to nadir in one audit. One check is cheap, but across a hundred epochs the chance of escaping every draw shrinks toward zero. Farmers would need every puppet to be audit-proof forever, which costs more than the scam could ever earn.
